observations: body L1-L10: the table goes on from p. 231; col. I repeats the results computed there (136° 10′ 12″, 134° 36′ 13″, 319° 25′ 40″, 314° 36′ 43″, 110° 11′ 22″, 111° 9′ 1″, 190° 11′ 10″, 185° 22′ 13″ and the southern latitude 0° 28′ 9″). The corrupt numbers of the codex («134», «4», «5») and of Plato («54», «91», «5», «109», «51») are printed in italics, Plato's «7» of the mean anomaly (L6) upright; the dots stand where Halley gives no number. The period after «Esc» in the head printed only as a speck; a speck between «vera» and «Lunae» (L5) and a hairline after Halley's «5» (L7) are not transcribed.
body L11-L12: the numbers are written in Maghribi abjad: «قلو» 136, «قلد» 134, «يا» 11, «د» 4, «ط» 9, «ه» 5. The dots of ي in «يا» are not printed, and «ه» prints as a solid round.
body L13: the dash before «Schiaparelli» measures 10.0 pt and is transcribed as a dash; the foot of the first L of «Schiaparelli» is broken off, so that the letter looks like an I with a speck.
body L14: the dash after «II.» measures 10.3 pt and is transcribed as a dash.
body L18, L33: the dashes of «ar–Raqqah» and «al–Battānī» are long dashes (5.6 and 5.5 pt).

body L21, L25, L27, L29, L31: the bars of «☾−⊙» (10.0 pt) and «O−T» (9.8 pt) in the text and in the head of the table, and those before «2′ 50″», «5m,7», «3 40» and «7, 3» (7.4 to 8.6 pt), are minus signs; the short bar of «O–T» in the head (4.2 pt) is transcribed as a dash.

body L25-L30: the times and places are those of the computations: I. 0h 47m, 139° 14′ 20″ and 139° 11′ 30″ (p. 227); II. 21h 20m, 308° 35′ 51″ and 308° 36′ 6″ (p. 229); III. 7h 48m, the first time of p. 230; IV. 15h 22m, 134° 36′ 13″ and 314° 36′ 43″ less 180° (p. 231). The eclipse of row I is that of 8 Āb 1202, 8 August 891 (p. 226); the row has 7 Aug. The differences of time answer to the differences of elongation at 2 minutes of time to 1′ (2′ 50″ 5m.7, 15″ 0m.5, 3′ 40″ 7m.3); at that rate the 30″ of row IV give 1m.0, where the print has 0m.1.

body L29: for 7h 48m al-Battānī's tables give the mean Sun 125° 20′ 31″ and, with the equation 1° 19′ 16″, the true Sun 124° 1′ 15″; the mean Moon 308° 41′ 17″, the mean anomaly 113° 9′ 29″, the double elongation 6° 41′ 32″, the correction of the anomaly 59′ 14″, the true anomaly 114° 8′ 43″, the simple equation 4° 43′ 51″ and the shadow in 123° 57′ 26″. The printed 123° 57′ 34″ is the 124° 1′ 24″ of p. 230 less 3′ 50″, the Moon's mean motion in 7 minutes; with the recomputed places ☾ − ⊙ is − 3′ 49″ and O − T − 7m.6.
body L32: a raised speck before «exspectandum» is not transcribed.
